meaning: to get along / to interact with
usage: Used to describe how people interact or get along with each other
Often refers to ongoing relationships rather than one-time interactions
Commonly paired with 好 / 唔好 to describe quality of interaction
Frequently used with 同 to indicate who someone gets along with

examples.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 tung4 si6 soeng1 cyu2 dak1 gei2 hou2
examples.meaning: I get along quite well with my colleagues.

examples.sentence: 同唔同人相處都需要耐性。
examples.jyutping: tung4 m4 tung4 jan4 soeng1 cyu2 dou1 seoi1 jiu3 noi6 sing3
examples.meaning: Getting along with different people all requires patience.
